tv-01.note: 對象 target or research subject (조사 대상 survey subjects) vs 大賞 grand prize (연기 대상 grand acting award). Different hanja roots sharing the exact same spelling.
Both mean cost, but 비용 is overall expenditure for an activity or project (여행 비용 travel costs), while 요금 is a fixed rate for using a service (버스 요금 bus fare).
Sound identical in isolation ([빋]). 빛 means optical light or glow (햇빛 sunlight), whereas 빚 means financial debt (빚을 갚다 to pay off debt).

tv-02.note: 상태 refers to the physical or mental condition of a person or object (건강 상태 health condition). 상황 refers to external circumstances or surroundings (경제 상황 economic situation).
Both mean to increase, but 높이다 raises grade, level, or quality (가치를 높이다 to raise value), while 늘리다 increases volume, count, or duration (생산량을 늘리다 to increase output).
構造 organization or framework (건물의 구조 building structure) vs 救助 rescue or relief from danger (조난자 구조 rescuing a stranded person). Context determines the meaning.

tv-03.note: 修理 physical repair or fixing (기계 수리 machine repair) vs 受理 formal acceptance and processing of an application (서류 수리 document acceptance). Unrelated hanja roots.
떠오르다 evokes an idea or mental image naturally floating up (좋은 생각이 떠오르다), whereas 생각나다 is actively recalling a forgotten piece of information (단어가 생각나다).
외부 denotes the exterior side of a boundary or outside an organization (외부 시선 outside perspective). 실외 specifically refers to the open air outdoors, opposite of 실내 (실외 수영장).

tv-04.note: 睡眠 sleep (수면 부족 lack of sleep) vs 水面 surface of water (수면 위 on the water). Same spelling and pronunciation, but completely different hanja and meanings.
家庭 family household or home (화목한 가정 harmonious home) vs 假定 hypothesis or supposition (가정을 세우다 to set up a hypothesis). Context clarifies the meaning.
담다 means placing items into a container or expressing sentiments (상자에 담다, 정성을 담다). 채우다 stresses filling a space to capacity (물병을 가득 채우다 to fill a bottle).

tv-05.note: 日程 daily schedule or itinerary (여행 일정 travel itinerary) vs 一定 uniform, fixed, or steady (일정한 온도 constant temperature). The first is a noun; the second functions as a determiner.
間 relationship or interval between groups (세대 간 between generations) vs 肝 biological liver (간 건강 liver health) vs salty seasoning (간을 맞추다 to season food).
Both mean excessive, but 지나치다 can also mean physically passing by a location (정류장을 지나치다 to miss a stop). 과하다 only means exceeding moderation (과한 요구 excessive request).

tv-06.note: 容器 container or vessel (플라스틱 용기 plastic container) vs 勇氣 courage or bravery (용기를 내다 to muster courage). Distinct hanja roots that share identical spelling.
機關 public institution or engine mechanism (정부 기관 government organization) vs 器官 biological bodily organ (소화 기관 digestive organ). Context distinguishes them.
야외 highlights natural open spaces and fields away from buildings (야외 공연 open-air performance). 실외 simply denotes the physical space immediately outside a room (실외기).

tv-07.note: Two native verbs: 맡다 ① to take charge of a duty or role (역할을 맡다) vs 맡다 ② to perceive an odor with the nose (향기를 맡다 to smell a fragrance).
賣場 retail outlet or shop counter (의류 매장 clothing store) vs 埋葬 burial in the earth (유물 매장 burial of artifacts). Two completely separate Sino-Korean words.
Both mean inexpensive, but 저렴하다 is polite and formal, preferred in commercial writing (저렴한 가격 affordable price), while 싸다 is casual everyday speech (값이 싸다).

tv-08.note: 時刻 point in time or clock time (도착 시각 arrival time) vs 視覺 visual sense (시각 장애 visual impairment) vs 視角 viewpoint or perspective (새로운 시각 fresh perspective).
洗劑 detergent or cleaning chemical (세탁 세제 laundry detergent) vs 稅制 national tax policy system (세제 혜택 tax benefit). Context makes the distinction obvious.
Both can mean to select or adopt, but 취하다 is formal and abstract (적절한 조치를 취하다 to take proper action), while 고르다 is everyday physical selection (선물을 고르다).

tv-09.note: Commonly confused homophones. 決濟 결제 is financial settlement or paying money (카드 결제 card payment). 決裁 결재 is approval from a workplace superior (서류 결재 document approval).
햇볕 highlights the warmth and heat radiated by the sun (햇볕에 말리다 to dry in the sun). 햇빛 emphasizes visual optical brightness and shine (눈부신 햇빛 bright sunlight).
가리다 ① to shield or conceal from sight (얼굴을 가리다 to cover one face). 가리다 ② to distinguish right from wrong or be finicky (시비를 가리다, 음식을 가리다 to be a picky eater).

tv-10.note: 記事 published news article or report (신문 기사 newspaper article) vs 技士 professional driver or technician (택시 기사 taxi driver). Both are very common in TOPIK II.
感情 human feeling or emotion (감정을 표현하다 to express emotion) vs 鑑定 expert appraisal of authenticity or value (보석 감정 gem appraisal). Unrelated hanja roots.
단점 is a drawback or disadvantage compared to strengths (장점과 단점 pros and cons). 결점 highlights a specific defect, flaw, or shortcoming needing repair (제품의 결점 product defect).
